Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
I enclose the list of the other copies of the [Dove](../books.html#62) to be sent out besides my own dozen.

Our day of departure is still fixed for Monday, but it is very likely to be put off till Friday. I suppose you naturally send copies of my books to the [Guardian](../others.html#75) but it is odd how it has ceased to notice them.

If [Miss Keary](../persons.html#793)’s new book is finished at the same time, I should be glad to have a copy in the parcel.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
